app_fee.value: The MUSC College of Graduate Studies application fee is $50 per application for Ph.D. programs ($250 matriculation fee upon acceptance).

also.quote: To be reviewed and considered for admission, all applicants must file their application with a non-refundable processing fee.

fee_waiver.value: No College of Graduate Studies application fee waiver policy is published on the admissions pages.

also.quote: To be reviewed and considered for admission, all applicants must file their application with a non-refundable processing fee.

gre_general.value: College-wide rules state individual colleges may require GRE or other exams; Biomedical Sciences and Neuroscience Ph.D. pages state standardized test scores are not required but will be considered if submitted (without naming GRE specifically).

also.quote: Submission of a standardized test score is not required but will be considered if submitted.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL score of 100 (scores must be no more than two years old; ETS institutional code 5407).
toefl_min.quote: Accepted tests are IELTS and TOEFL. Minimal requirements are: TOEFL: 100 IELTS: 7

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS overall score of 7 (scores must be no more than two years old).
ielts_min.quote: Accepted tests are IELTS and TOEFL. Minimal requirements are: TOEFL: 100 IELTS: 7

english_waiver.value: Case-by-case exceptions may be made for extended study at a U.S. institution or at a foreign institution where English is the primary language of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: A language proficiency test is required for all applicants whose native language is not English. Scores must not be more than two years old. Exceptions can be made if a student has attended a United States institution for an extended period. An exception might also be made for students in a foreign institution that uses English as the primary language for instruction, however, these are made on a case-by-case basis.

notes: MUSC College of Graduate Studies applications use GradCAS followed by the MUSC Supplemental Application; non-U.S. transcripts require a NACES-member professional evaluation. Ph.D. in Biomedical Sciences and Ph.D. in Neuroscience both state that standardized test score submission is not required but considered if submitted.
